evidence: frontend/apps/reality-web/src/app/[locale]/account/listings/[id]/edit/page.tsx:201 — handleSave sends `price: typeof form.price === 'number' ? form.price : Number(form.price) || 0`. The price input (line 632) stores '' when cleared, so Number('') === 0 and `0 || 0` === 0: clearing or mistyping the price silently persists the listing at price 0 instead of rejecting the edit.

page.tsx:816-817 — the Save button is only guarded by `disabled={saving}`; there is no required/validation gate on price before handleSave runs, so the 0-coercion is reachable with a normal user edit. Area/rooms/floor use `|| undefined` (omitted, acceptable) but price falls back to a concrete 0 — a data-integrity bug on a public listing's headline figure.

Confidence medium: static trace of the submit path + button guard is clear, but server-side price validation was not traced; if the backend rejects price=0 the impact is a confusing save failure rather than a 0-priced listing.

frontend/apps/reality-web/src/lib/comparison-context.tsx:40-41 — on mount `const parsed = JSON.parse(stored); setListings(parsed)` casts the localStorage value straight into `ListingSummary[]` with no Array.isArray/shape check. The surrounding try/catch only catches JSON syntax errors.

A syntactically-valid but wrong-shape stored value (e.g. a legacy or tampered 'ppt-comparison' entry holding `{}`, `true`, or a bare number) passes JSON.parse, sets non-array state, and then makes later `listings.some(...)` (line 66) and the render `.map` throw 'listings.some is not a function', breaking the comparison provider for that visitor until storage is cleared. Low severity (requires corrupt/tampered client storage) but a straightforward hardening gap vs the equivalent guarded parsing in lib/auth-token.ts.
